HOW IT HELPS

How it works
in everyday life.

CITI brings useful locations together on an interactive map. Select the categories you need to see places such as shelters, resilience centres, water points and charging stations.

When it comes in handy

In a part of town you do not know well? Open the map and select the category you need to find a nearby location.

Categories and locations depend on the data available in each community.
